title: Click Off Heist
style: Phonk with dusty vinyl crackle, tight sub pulses, and syncopated phone tap clicks; intro whispers and chopped ad-libs before a stripped verse, pre-chorus lifts with filtered risers and snapped claps, chorus hits with gang repeats and sharp stop-start edits, bridge slows to half-time with echo tails, final hook returns fuller and meaner. Dark, punchy, close-mic mix with crisp top end., simple, smooth, strong, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
Click... off...
Click off... click off...
Click next... click move...
Click X...
(Click off)

[Chorus]
Click off, click off, click next, click move
Click X if it don't improve
Don't like what you see?
Move, move, move
Heist life, no loose ends
I choose, choose, choose
Precision clicks, strategic moves
Bad energy flashing — click, click, click — remove
Move, move, move — that's the groove
Heist complete, I don't lose

[Verse 1]
Late night scroll like I'm casing the vault
Quick assessment, no time to default
One red flag and the whole play's at fault
So I click X clean with no salt
Heist mentality — in and out, no trace
If the vibe's off, I'm already in another place
Smooth operator in the digital chase
Move on to the next play, elevate the pace
They call it cold, I call it calculated
Protecting my peace, that's how I made it
No fingerprints left on decisions I hated
Click move to the mission that’s properly weighted

[Chorus]
Click off, click off, click next, click move
Click X if it don't improve
Don't like what you see?
Move, move, move
Heist life, no loose ends
I choose, choose, choose
Precision clicks, strategic moves
Bad energy flashing — click, click, click — remove
Move, move, move — that's the groove
Heist complete, I don't lose

[Verse 2]
Standards high like the getaway car
Only the real make it past the radar
Swagger on a hundred, phonk in the scar
Every click a choice, every move is art
Don't like the picture? Hit delete and depart
I don't argue with the screen, I just restart
Heist the bag, heist the dream, heist the heart
Click X on distractions, stay sharp, play smart
They wonder why I don't stick around long
Simple — I move with purpose, I move strong
Life's too short for the mediocre song
Click through the static till the real one belongs

[Bridge]
In this game of clicks and swipes
You gotta know when to roll the dice
When it's wrong, don't think twice
Click off... move on... that's the heist
(yeah)

[Chorus]
Click off, click off, click next, click move
Click X if it don't improve
Don't like what you see?
Move, move, move
Heist life, no loose ends
I choose, choose, choose
Precision clicks, strategic moves
Bad energy flashing — click, click, click — remove
Move, move, move — that's the groove
Heist complete, I don't lose

[Outro]
Click off... click next...
Move... move move...
Heist complete.
